inventory.title: Adventure 5-in-1 Inflatable Water Park
inventory.description: The ultimate water play adventure! Features dual racing slides, climbing wall, water cannons, sprinkler arch, splash pool, and integrated sports play zone.

inventory.title: Premium White Fan-Back Folding Chair
inventory.description: Heavy-duty commercial folding chairs in a sleek fan-back style — perfect for weddings, birthdays, banquets and outdoor corporate gatherings.

inventory.title: Red Cotton Candy Cart
inventory.description: Professional high-yield cotton candy maker on a mobile trolley. Adds nostalgic joy and sweet treats to any event.

inventory.title: Summer Waves Double-Slide Splash Kingdom
inventory.description: Multi-activity inflatable bounce kingdom with safety netting, basketball hoop, giant splash pool and automatic water bucket drop.

inventory.title: Round Banqueting Table (60-inch)
inventory.description: Premium heavy-duty round tables built for high-end dining setups. Seats 8–10 guests comfortably.

inventory.title: Theatre-Style Popcorn Maker
inventory.description: Fresh, hot popcorn in minutes! Comes with a stand and all starter ingredients (corn, oil, butter salt).

inventory.title: Interactive Open-Air Photo Booth
inventory.description: Fully digital touchscreen booth with instant SMS / email delivery, custom frames, props, and green screen backdrop.

inventory.title: Professional Snow-cone Machine
inventory.description: High-yield commercial-grade snow-cone shaver. Easy to operate and produces perfectly crushed ice for cool summer treats.

inventory.title: Cotton Candy Kit (50 Servings)
inventory.description: Sweet cotton candy sugar floss and cones — yields approximately 50 servings. Works perfectly with our cotton candy makers.

inventory.title: Popcorn Kit (50 Servings)
inventory.description: Theatre-style popcorn kits including gourmet kernels, coconut oil, and seasoning salt — yields approximately 50 servings.

inventory.title: Snow-cone Kit (50 Servings)
inventory.description: Premium snow-cone syrups and cups — yields approximately 50 cool, refreshing servings.

inventory.title: Equipment Stand
inventory.description: Heavy-duty mobile equipment stand designed to hold and showcase our concession machinery.

inventory.title: Additional Rental Hour
inventory.description: Additional hourly service/rental time for concession machinery.
